description: Compare the lowest one-way or round-trip fare for each departure date across up to 31 dates. Every date is checked. Search the chosen date with search_flights for bookable itineraries.

cabin_class.description: Preferred cabin class: economy, premium_economy, business, or first.
cabin_class.title: Cabin Class

departure_date_end.description: Last departure date to compare, in YYYY-MM-DD format; at most 30 days after the start.
departure_date_end.title: Departure Date End

departure_date_start.description: First departure date to compare, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
departure_date_start.title: Departure Date Start

destination.description: Destination airport or metro IATA code.
destination.title: Destination

infants_in_seat.description: Number of infants traveling with their own seat.
infants_in_seat.title: Infants In Seat

infants_on_lap.description: Number of infants traveling on an adult's lap.
infants_on_lap.title: Infants On Lap

market.description: 2-letter market or country code affecting pricing and results.
market.title: Market

max_price.description: Maximum whole-trip price in the market currency.
max_price.title: Max Price

max_stops.description: Maximum number of stops in each direction.
max_stops.title: Max Stops

origin.description: Origin airport or metro IATA code.
origin.title: Origin

stay_days.description: Omit for one-way. For round trips, return this many days after each departure.
stay_days.title: Stay Days

name: search_cheapest_dates

price.description: Lowest qualifying whole-trip fare for the party. Null when the search found no qualifying quote.

status.description: A priced date has a qualifying fare. A no_price date was checked and had no qualifying quote.
status.title: Status

observed_at.description: UTC time Ignav finished retrieving these prices; null when unknown. Not a guarantee of current fares.
observed_at.title: Observed At

title: Search cheapest dates
